    • approveBinding

      void approveBinding(@NonNull String digitalCardID, @NonNull String bindingReference, @Nullable BindReason reason, @NonNull D1Task.Callback<Void> callback)
      Deprecated.
      Use stepUpAuthenticationResult(String, String, Result) instead.
      Approves the device binding for a digital card.
      Parameters:
      digitalCardID - The unique identifier of the digital card.
      bindingReference - Corresponds to Visa device index.
      reason - The reason for device binding approval. If it is not provided, it defaults to BindReason.ISSUER_DECISION.
      callback - The callback for the result. When it is successful, the returned argument of D1Task.Callback.onSuccess(Object) is always null.
      Possible errors:
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_NOT_LOGGED_IN
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_NOT_AUTHORIZED
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_DEVICE_ENVIRONMENT_UNSAFE

      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_CARD_NOT_FOUND
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_CARD

    • parseStepUpVerificationDetails

      @NonNull static StepUpAuthenticationDetails parseStepUpVerificationDetails(@NonNull String verificationDetails) throws D1Exception
      Parses step-up verification details from a Base64-encoded JSON payload.

      This static utility method extracts and normalizes verification details from token service provider payloads (Visa and Mastercard) to facilitate step-up authentication workflows.

      The method supports both Visa and Mastercard payload formats and automatically detects the format based on the presence of specific fields.

      Parameters:
      verificationDetails - Base64-encoded JSON string containing verification details from the token service provider
      Returns:
      Parsed StepUpAuthenticationDetails object containing normalized verification information
      Throws:
      D1Exception - with D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT if:
      • The input is null or empty
      • The Base64 encoding is invalid
      • The JSON format is malformed
      • Required fields are missing
      • The payload format is not recognized (neither Visa nor Mastercard)
      Since:
      4.6.0
      See Also:
      • StepUpAuthenticationDetails

    • stepUpAuthenticationResult

      @NonNull Task<Void> stepUpAuthenticationResult(@NonNull String digitalCardID, @NonNull String authenticationID, @NonNull Result result)
      Performs step-up authentication for device binding and cardholder verification.

      Usage:

      1. Parse the verification details from the token service provider using parseStepUpVerificationDetails(String)
      2. Extract the digitalCardID using StepUpAuthenticationDetails.getDigitalCardID()
      3. Extract the authenticationID using StepUpAuthenticationDetails.getAuthenticationID()
      4. Perform user authentication and determine the result
      5. Call this method with the extracted values and authentication result
      Parameters:
      digitalCardID - The unique identifier of the digital card. Use StepUpAuthenticationDetails.getDigitalCardID() to obtain this value from the parsed verification details.
      authenticationID - A unique identifier for the authentication session. Use StepUpAuthenticationDetails.getAuthenticationID() to obtain this value from the parsed verification details.
      result - The result of the step-up authentication. See Result.
      Returns:
      A Task that executes the operation asynchronously. When successful, the task returns null. On failure, throws D1Exception.
      Possible errors:
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_NOT_LOGGED_IN
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_NOT_AUTHORIZED
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_DEVICE_ENVIRONMENT_UNSAFE
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_CORE
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_CARD_NOT_FOUND
      • D1Exception.ErrorCode.ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT
      Since:
      4.6.0
